sorries.obstruction: Mathlib has no compactness criterion in L^p. Prepared here: the Euclidean cell approximation Half.cell_approx (for v C¹ on ℍ̄ vanishing outside a ball, ‖v − P_δ v‖²_{L²(ℍ̄)} ≤ 2·2^N N δ² ‖Dv‖²_{L²(ℍ̄)}, P_δ v the piecewise-constant function of the averages on the grid cubes of side δ, finitely many of them for fixed R, δ). Missing, in order: (1) the finiteness of a locally-Lebesgue μ on compact M (good charts with bounded image, finite subcover); (2) the chart-level assembly: with the partition of unity of Mfd.assemble, v_i = Mfd.chartFun (ρ_i u) is C¹ on ℍ̄ with support in the fixed compact φ_i(tsupport ρ_i), ‖Dv_i‖_{L²(ℍ̄)} ≤ C‖u‖_{W^{1,2}} (the steps of Mfd.local_sobolev), and ‖ρ_i u − (P_δ v_i)∘φ_i‖_{L²(μ)} ≤ C‖v_i − P_δ v_i‖_{L²(ℍ̄)} (Mfd.eLpNorm_chart_comparable); (3) the total-boundedness wrapper: the coefficients avg_{C_z}(v_i(u_k)) are bounded, the finite-rank map from coefficients to Lp ℝ 2 μ (indicatorConstLp of the cells V_i ∩ φ_i⁻¹ C_z) sends a closed ball to a compact set, so the W^{1,2}-ball is totally bounded in the complete Lp ℝ 2 μ (TotallyBounded.closure, isCompact_of_isClosed, IsCompact.tendsto_subseq).

To integrate: delete Mfd.sobolev_embedding, Mfd.eLpNorm_gradNorm_lt_top (Sobolev.lean:374, 387), Mfd.trace_embedding (Trace.lean:398) and the bridges Mfd.Reads.sobolevIneq/kobayashiB/prop_nonpositive_csc (Sobolev.lean:457–487), Mfd.Reads.traceIneq (Trace.lean:426) from round 1's files, and rename the primed ones (ManifoldTheorems.lean; each is rfl-checked to have the round-1 statement); then make Rellich.lean import YamabeScaffold.Compactness and point Mfd.Reads.rellichProp, Mfd.Reads.lem_positivity, Mfd.Reads.cor_negative at them. FINDING ON THE ROUND-1 LEAN (not on the paper): Mfd.const_of_tendsto (Rellich.lean:470) is false as stated, because it asks no measurability of f and eLpNorm of a non-measurable f is an inner integral: with u_k = 0 and f = 1_S for a set S with μ S ≠ 0 all of whose measurable subsets are null (classically a Vitali set in a chart; its existence is not formalized here), the hypotheses hold and the conclusion fails (Mfd.not_const_of_tendsto proves this implication for any such S). The same holds for MeasuredModel.ConstLimit (Rellich.lean:98) on any model reading such an M, so Mfd.Reads.constLimit (Rellich.lean:516) cannot be closed. Fix (small): add 'MemLp f 2 (M.vol g) →' (or AEStronglyMeasurable) to ConstLimit; MeasuredModel.lem_positivity applies it only to the Rellich limit, which is MemLp (Rellich.lean:208), toy_constLimit and toyCut_not_constLimit survive (Bool is discrete); then Mfd.Reads.constLimit is Mfd.Reads.constLimit_of_aestronglyMeasurable (Compactness.lean).
